user.title: Sign in to Panasonic account
user.description: Enter the credentials for your Panasonic Smart app account (China mainland). One integration entry is created per account; every ERV device on that account shares the same login session.

devices.title: Select ERV devices
devices.description: Choose one or more Panasonic ERV devices to control from this account. You can add or remove devices later from the integration options.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Panasonic account
reauth_confirm.description: The saved session for {username} is no longer valid. Enter the account password to refresh it.

error.cannot_connect: Login failed: check your account credentials or network connection
error.no_devices_found: No devices found: verify that devices are bound to this account
error.no_supported_devices_found: No supported ERV devices found: only 0800/0850 category SmallERV and MidERV devices are currently supported
error.token_generation_failed: Token generation failed: the device ID format is invalid
error.no_devices_selected: Select at least one ERV device

abort.already_configured: This Panasonic account is already configured. Use Configure to add or remove devices.

init.title: ERV devices on this account
init.description: Select the ERV devices Home Assistant should control. Unchecked devices are removed from this integration.
